sentence: Tidy passes: At most 8 edits (merge, move under, possibly renamed, rename, create a parent for related topics, refile a thread), each with a one-line reason. A move under a parent drops the words the names share: "Vercel Agent Code Review" moves under "Vercel Agent" as "Code Review". With organizing suggestions on, a pass runs after changes to topic definitions or visible root membership and filing settle. Checks are debounced by two seconds; titles and statuses alone do not start a pass. Applicable tidy edits waiting for review pause automatic passes; after a decision, changed work is assessed. Ask now runs splits and a pass right away, replacing pending tidy edits. A tidy pass sees at most 12 threads per topic and 12 Unfiled threads; it can propose thread moves only for the threads shown in that call.

The newer SDK's internal_DO_NOT_USE_openTunnelIngress is explicitly Connect-only, and its implementation verifies Connect assertions and marks requests remote. sentence: Each thread shows its workstream (click it to open Topics) and title above its latest recap card. Under the card:
context:
heading: Workstreams page (/plugins/workstreams/home)
preceding: Open Workstreams in the main navigation panel. The page is a queue that shows one thing at a time that needs you: Up Next's threads in the sidebar's order, then the organizer's suggestions. The order holds while the page is open. The next items wait as a stack of cards behind the current one, the next two peeking out above it. Acting on an item, or skipping it, tucks its card under: it drops clear of the stack, slips behind it, and rises to the back while the others move up a place; going back reverses the path. A card too tall to fit behind the next one fades away on its way. A moving card follows a sideways loop and banks slightly. Presses are taken one card at a time, at least 60 ms apart and only when the previous card clears; a press that arrives while one waits is dropped, and a press the other way is always taken. Holding ↓ moves cards on, and holding ↑ brings them back. Repeats start after 250 ms and run every 25 ms. As a hold continues, the springs stiffen and clearing loosens while cards stay whole; letting go rests on a whole card. When a card comes back from behind the stack it regains its colour, and the card it is about to cover dims its content and shrinks to the size it will have under it, keeping its frame and background. Under reduced motion the new item only fades in. To look ahead or back without acting, use the footer's arrows, which also show where you are ("2 of 9"), or press ↓, → or J for the next item and ↑, ← or K for the previous one. The card stack's top edge sits about a quarter of the way down the page, and the heading sits in a fixed place just above the stack. The replies and actions follow the card and the page grows downward, so opening Reply, holding Shift, or a receipt appearing above never moves anything. The stack keeps that place from item to item and follows the window as you resize it; it only glides down when the next item's heading wraps to more lines. The new heading fades in place; the receipt line crossfades to the next one with a small drift. Under reduced motion the card only fades in and the heading changes in place.

preceding: Empty workstreams: Workstreams can briefly keep New work available: at most 3 recently emptied workstreams are retained, and only while they had a visible, non-archived, unsnoozed thread within the last 10 minutes. sentence: The instructions teach that strict form, but a component still renders when its writer's intent is clear: single, curly, or backtick quotes; unquoted text; missing or extra commas; = for :; positional arguments; names in another case, a common synonym, or a small misspelling that points at one field; enum words such as Passed, ok, or not tested; numbers and booleans written as text; a single value where a list belongs; a string for a step or evidence entry; unknown fields, which are dropped; indented """ text; nested groups, which flatten; and a Workstreams or workstream fence. sentence: Trace recording & redaction: Every Quick analysis, Full analysis, placement, category, split, and tidy model call records its redacted input, prompt, raw response, reasoning summary, parsed output, token usage, cost, duration, and applied outcome. Common secret patterns (sk-…, ghp_…, github_pat_…, xoxb-…, Bearer …, and api_key/token/password/secret assignments) are masked before prompts reach a model or trace store. Redaction is best effort, not a security boundary; do not put secrets in requests or assume diagnostics are safe to share without inspection. Conversation excerpts go to your selected model provider under that provider's policies. Traces are retained for 7 days or 1,000 records and pruned automatically even after Debug mode is turned off.

Show N more lists the trimmed threads that are unread or blocked on you below the rest, and Show less collapses them; trimmed read threads not blocked on you stay in Recent and their workstreams. It re-ranks as recaps, read state, and activity change. The thread you have open keeps its row and place until you open another thread. Nested delegates do not appear as separate Up Next entries; find them in their workstream's thread tree.
preceding: Use the Sort workstreams menu to order workstreams by Name A–Z, Recent activity, or Manual order (drag headers within their tier).

sentence: All CLI execution uses argv arrays with shell: false; selectors, names, source forms, and operation kinds are validated. Task directories come from fresh Workforest metadata, not browser-supplied paths. Commands have time/output limits and process-group cancellation on plugin disposal. Normal read calls expire after 24 seconds; mutations run for up to 15 minutes. Workforest's independent background initializers may continue after its initiating CLI exits. Refresh status before retrying an interrupted operation.

preceding: Workforest owns Git worktrees, workspace metadata, setup, branch policy, and integration checks. BB sees existing checkouts as attached environments and newly-created checkouts as provider-owned environments. BB owns thread creation; Workforest remains the authority for checkout lifecycle and deletion.
